title: Administrative Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The purpose of this position is to provide primary coordination and facilitation of training and education programs affiliated with the MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center Howard University Regional Partner and the College of Pharmacy. Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance and provides assistance for all activities planned by the project including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects including: Regional Main , Minority AIDS Initiative, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and others as appropriate.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills.
  • Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organize and facilitate monthly video conference calls, in person/online meetings, training events. Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded, and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Facilitate training at all levels on topics of relevance to the school or department, including the creation of training and education for the program.
  • Work with subcontractors to ensure the programs identify training needs, effectively reach targeted audiences, and enhance the quality of education.
  • Manage the certification process for continuing education credits for designated professions.
  • Increase the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organizations, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participate in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Support the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and providing appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintain files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and help organize all required documentation to and from funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meet program quarterly goals and create reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on project outcomes and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.

Core Competencies

  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Skill in operation of computers, related software applications (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Access).
  • Knowledge of standard office equipment.
  • Knowledge and skill in accounting and budgeting techniques and principles.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with a diverse population.
  • Must be detail oriented and organized.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high‑level of confidentiality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, residents, students and the general public. Knowledge of creating and managing contracts for vendors, data entry, spreadsheets.
  • Ability to work independently to assist in paperwork for processing of grant funds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business or administration and 3-6 years of experience. Five years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$42,000-52,000

Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.

PROCESSO SELETIVO

1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:

1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.

1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato; caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.

1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail). O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso.

1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.

1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.

1.7.6 O Processo Seletivo será composto de:

  • 1ª ETAPA – Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 2ª ETAPA – Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
  • 3ª ETAPA – Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
  • 4ª ETAPA – Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.

Somente o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado terá direito à contratação.

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Function: HV Services
Requisition ID:

Senior Technical Consultant- RJ

The Senior Technical Consultant is ultimately responsible for leading large, complex, customer engagements, and ensuring the technical success of the Global Delivery Services. With a requirement for the combination of coaching junior consultants, leading solution designs, troubleshooting, escalation management, and hands‑on delivery. The Senior TC will also work closely with the project manager to ensure project status is communicated, a plan is in place, and progress is being made to achieve project completion. The role will apply advanced subject matter expertise to complex business issues; working on multifaceted problems/projects where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Within our delivery centers, the role expects a high degree of technical aptitude and attention to detail at all times. They are expected to perform independently and carry out Storage, Compute, Data Protection, and other technical activities autonomously. They have a strong understanding of the overall IT Infrastructure components, especially Storage, Compute & Data Protection technologies and have a deep knowledge of ITIL processes & services and can put them into practice as & where needed. They drive customer projects and can provide resolutions to escalated issues & problems. They are expected to mentor the junior staff and write detailed process documents, work‑instructions, and run‑books.

What you will bring

  • Perform & lead innovative Delivery Services for Hitachi Vantara customers as defined in a Statement of Work
  • Create detailed technical designs from high level solution designs, based on an analysis of the customer's environment and requirements
  • Take strategic decisions in consultation with Service Delivery Manager (SDM) / Project Manager (PM) based on the most relevant factors available that drive effectiveness and value to the customer
  • Provide technical subject expertise to troubleshoot and identify operational, connectivity and network issues, providing rational business cases and arguments to persuade upwardly and with peers
  • Assist with the creation of new innovative delivery collateral and maintenance of existing delivery collateral. Recommending improvements in order to increase efficiency, effectiveness and pioneering customer success
  • Provide analysis and implementation support for SAN/NAS Storage solutions, initial implementation, and integration into the environment as required
  • Provide input into the creation, establishment and maintenance of IT policies, procedures and practices using ITIL framework to efficiently manage the storage infrastructure
  • Provide input to the Service Delivery Manager for the monthly governance meetings and reports with the customer and Hitachi.
  • Coach and train technical consultants, whilst also providing guidance to local teams or 3rd party partners, building mutual support, and understanding with colleagues
  • Supports the SDM & PM in strengthening the relationship with the customer
  • Identify and provide suggested continuous improvement initiatives within the account

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5+ years technical consultancy and enterprise experience
  • 7+ years technical IT related experience
  • At least five years' experience within Hitachi technologies, a similar competitor organization, end user or IT consultancy services provider
  • A demonstrated problem solver, mentor, coach, and leader who can work independently, is well organized, and always pays close attention to detail
  • A willingness to work a flexible schedule and to travel is a must for this role
  • Demonstrate strong presentation skills on technical subjects
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers at all levels

About us

Championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are integral to our culture and identity. Diverse thinking, a commitment to allyship, and a culture of empowerment help us achieve powerful results. We want you to be you, with all the ideas, lived experience, and fresh perspective that brings. We support your uniqueness and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our team.

How we look after you

We want to help you take care of your today and tomorrow - at home and at work. Which is why we offer industry‑leading benefits that go far beyond compensation. That means support, services, and resources that also take care of your holistic health and wellbeing. We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. Here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent).

We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Site Manager (Projetos Industriais)
description:
Estamos em busca de um/a Site Manager, que será responsável por gerenciar obras industriais integrando disciplinas, garantindo qualidade, produtividade, conformidade técnica e entrega segura da planta ao cliente. Este/a profissional atuará em uma de nossas obras na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ, tendo estas atribuições principais:

  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento e revisão de projetos multidisciplinares industriais (civil, mecânico, elétrico, instrumentação e automação), buscando ganhos de produtividade, padronização de processos construtivos, inovação tecnológica e redução de riscos operacionais e de montagem;
  • Definir e coordenar a matriz de riscos dos elementos de obras industriais, antecipando falhas potenciais em interfaces disciplinares, riscos de montagem mecânica, riscos de segurança operacional, desvios de performance dos equipamentos e impactos financeiros;
  • Assegurar a execução com qualidade dos serviços, garantindo conformidade com especificações técnicas, normas internacionais aplicáveis, metodologias executivas específicas que atendam aos requisitos operacionais da planta em construção;
  • Compatibilizar o projeto com o escopo contratual, analisando a viabilidade das metodologias de montagem, interligações de sistemas e sequenciamento construtivo, otimizando soluções técnicas para reduzir custos, retrabalhos e riscos de parada ou atraso de startup;
  • Atuar em parceria com Suprimentos na especificação técnica e aquisição de materiais e equipamentos, buscando fornecedores internacionais, garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade normativa, custo-benefício e gestão eficiente de estoque e entregas;
  • Aplicar conhecimentos das principais modalidades contratuais utilizadas em obras industriais, desenhando estratégias adequadas para cada contexto e suas interfaces multidisciplinares, mantendo profundo conhecimento do contrato;
  • Elaborar e sustentar reinvindicações (claims) e aditivos, quando necessário, visando a manutenção do equilíbrio contratual e a proteção dos indicadores de performance do projeto;
  • Realizar a gestão contratual rigorosa com subcontratados, assegurando cumprimento de obrigações técnicas, regulatórias e de SMS, mitigando passivos e garantindo medições precisas, rastreáveis e conformes ao avanço físico real;
  • Compreender o desempenho econômico-financeiro de projetos industriais, analisando CAPEX, OPEX, curva S integrada por disciplina, impactos de equipamentos estratégicos e variações cambiais em contratos internacionais.
  • Manter relacionamento transparente com sindicatos, órgãos reguladores, Corpo de Bombeiros, órgãos ambientais e auditorias técnicas, garantindo observância à legislação trabalhista, NR’s e normas industriais aplicáveis, preservando a segurança empresarial;
  • Priorizar a Segurança do Trabalho desde as fases de engenharia até a execução, implantando cultura de intolerância a acidentes, gestão de energias perigosas, análises de risco operacionais e práticas avançadas de controle de processo;
  • Coordenar atividades de pré-comissionamento e completação mecânica, desenvolve planos e procedimentos de comissionamento, manuais de operação e manutenção, matrizes de testes e controles rigorosos de qualidade e riscos operacionais;
  • Planejar e gerenciar a partida da planta industrial, coordenando testes operacionais, energização de sistemas elétricos, calibração de instrumentos, testes de performance e integração com a equipe de operação, garantindo entrega segura e funcional ao cliente.
  • Formação Superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação e/ou MBA em Gerenciamento de Projetos, Gestão da Construção Civil, Segurança de Processos Industriais ou Gestão de Riscos;
  • Sólida experiência como Site Manager em obras do ramo industrial, sobretudo em plantas químicas e/ou petroquímicas;
  • Amplo conhecimento das modalidades de contratos e subcontratos e suas implicações no andamento do projeto;
  • Conhecimentos acerca dos principais softwares do Pacote Office, sobretudo Excel;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região do Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:

✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações

A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

description:
Senior Technical Consultant – RJ

The Senior Technical Consultant is ultimately responsible for leading large, complex, customer engagements, and ensuring the technical success of the Global Delivery Services. With a requirement for coaching junior consultants, leading solution designs, troubleshooting, escalation management, and hands‑on delivery, the Senior TC will also work closely with the project manager to ensure project status is communicated, a plan is in place, and progress is being made to achieve project completion.

The role will apply advanced subject matter expertise to complex business issues; working on multifaceted problems/projects where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors. Within our delivery centers, the role expects a high degree of technical aptitude and attention to detail at all times. They are expected to perform independently and carry out storage, compute, data protection, and other technical activities autonomously. They have a strong understanding of the overall IT infrastructure components, especially storage, compute & data protection technologies and a deep knowledge of ITIL processes & services and can put them into practice as & where needed. They drive customer projects and can provide resolutions to escalated issues & problems.

They’re expected to mentor junior staff and write detailed process documents, work‑instructions, and run‑books.

What you will bring

  • Perform & lead innovative Delivery Services for Hitachi Vantara customers as defined in a Statement of Work.
  • Create detailed technical designs from high level solution designs, based on an analysis of the customer’s environment and requirements.
  • Take strategic decisions in consultation with Service Delivery Manager (SDM) / Project Manager (PM) based on the most relevant factors available that drive effectiveness and value to the customer.
  • Provide technical subject expertise to troubleshoot and identify operational, connectivity and network issues, providing rational business cases and arguments to persuade upwardly and with peers.
  • Assist with the creation of new innovative delivery collateral and maintenance of existing delivery collateral. Recommending improvements in order to increase efficiency, effectiveness and pioneering customer success.
  • Provide analysis and implementation support for SAN/NAS Storage solutions, initial implementation, and integration into the environment as required.
  • Provide input into the creation, establishment and maintenance of IT policies, procedures and practices using ITIL framework to efficiently manage the storage infrastructure.
  • Provide input to the Service Delivery Manager for the monthly governance meetings and reports with the customer and Hitachi.
  • Coach and train technical consultants, whilst also providing guidance to local teams or 3rd party partners, building mutual support, and understanding with colleagues.
  • Supports the SDM & PM in strengthening the relationship with the customer.
  • Identify and provide suggested continuous improvement initiatives within the account.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5+ years technical consultancy and enterprise experience.
  • A minimum of 7+ years technical IT related experience.
  • At least five years’ experience within Hitachi technologies, a similar competitor organization, end user or IT consultancy services provider.
  • A demonstrated problem solver, mentor, coach, and leader who can work independently, is well organized, and always pays close attention to detail.
  • A willingness to work a flexible schedule and to travel is a must for this role.
  • Demonstrate strong presentation skills on technical subjects.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with customers at all levels.

About us

Championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are integral to our culture and identity. We support your uniqueness and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our team.

Benefits

We want to help you take care of your today and tomorrow – at home and at work. That includes industry‑leading benefits that go far beyond compensation, support, services, and resources that also take care of your holistic health and wellbeing. title: Técnico(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

  1. Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  2. Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  3. Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  4. Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  5. Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  6. Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  7. Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  8. Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  9. Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação Técnica em Automação;
  • Ter experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial;
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Local de trabalho: Sorocaba - SP;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Antes de falarmos sobre a vaga, que tal entender um pouco sobre nós?

Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas em suas diferentes origens, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, orientações sexuais e gerações.

O PROPÓSITO DO GRUPO PROFARMA É ENTREGAR SAÚDE!

  • Conhecimento em etiquetagem têxtil e requisitos regulamentares legais.
  • Experiência em inspeção de matéria‑prima e gestão de fornecedores.
  • Domínio do pacote Office; experiência com Linx ou ERP similar.
  • Perfil: comunicação clara, liderança, orientação a resultados e controle de processos.

title: Principal Genesys Cloud PS Consultant
description:
Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands-on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high-quality solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys-related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect.
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features.
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce.

Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

title: Senior Compliance Counsel
description:
Senior Compliance Counsel

Department: Legal & Compliance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Compliance Counsel under the guidance of the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 and the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department will provide compliance support and oversight in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and help to ensure that FWWC 2027’s activities comply with applicable compliance laws and regulations and meet best practices.

The FWWC 2027 is seeking an experienced individual to be an integral part of the FWWC 2027 team, responsible for implementing and overseeing a comprehensive governance and compliance programme throughout the organisation.

This person will act as a point of reference in Brazil for compliance‑related matters within FWWC 2027, as well as be the compliance liaison for the FIFA Compliance and Risk Department in Miami.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance

  • Establish a framework to identify, prioritize and enable the effective and efficient management of compliance risks facing the organisation through periodic compliance risk assessment.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Compliance and Risk team in Miami to design, implement and periodically review compliance policies and procedures governing key risk areas such conflicts of interest, anti‑bribery and corruption, anti‑money laundering/KYC, gifts and entertainment, etc.
  • Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the compliance programme activities.
  • Provide ad hoc compliance and governance related advice.
  • Design and work with HR and Internal Communications to develop and deliver a compliance awareness and training programme.
  • Liaise with external counsel on compliance matters.
  • If applicable, liaise with regulators and auditors.
  • Perform investigations and advise on whistleblower and hotline case management.
  • Advise on third‑party risk and management, including implementing and overseeing third‑party due diligence processes.
  • Manage conflicts of interest, including any required disclosures associated with such conflicts of interest.
  • Key point of reference for the Head of Legal FWWC 2027 on all compliance matters in Brazil.
  • Act as main compliance delegate for overall FWWC 2027 risk management activities, including timely implementation of compliance risk mitigation plans.

General

  • Demonstrate a team‑based approach to achieving the best outcomes for FWWC 2027 in accordance with FIFA’s values.
  • Ensure productive working relationships with all the relevant stakeholders (FIFA, CBF, Host Cities, stadium authorities, government entities, FIFA’s Commercial Affiliates, multilateral development institutions, NGOs and local communities).
  • Demonstrate an understanding of FWWC 2027’s commercial drivers and desired outcomes, and a willingness to take a hands‑on approach.
  • Manage the escalation process for compliance risks.
  • Drive process efficiency and policy improvement.
  • Ensure the assigned responsibilities are delivered: to a high standard of quality and timeliness; in full compliance with the safety and security rules and requirements of FWWC 2027 and FIFA; and in line with any applicable key performance indicators.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Laws
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil (or the ability to easily obtain this qualification)
  • Fluency in English

Experience

  • A minimum of 4 - 5 years’ experience as a qualified lawyer, with in‑house experience preferred
  • Experience in compliance or a related field.
  • Excellent writing skills
  • Good analytical and organisational skills
  • Experience with sporting or events organisations or commercial rights holders/sponsorship

Other knowledge and skills

  • Experience in MS Office programmes (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams)
  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and follow‑through
  • Capable of balancing legal and commercial outcomes
  • Ability to manage competing priorities
  • Skilled at time management
  • Skilled in problem solving, solution‑oriented and pragmatic
  • Flexibility and a related ability to work autonomously in a dynamic and fast‑paced environment
  • A team player who is skilled at building relationships internally and externally
  • Empathetic, collaborative and patient, with a positive attitude
  • Ability to communicate efficiently in multi‑stakeholder environments
  • Strong identification with the FIFA World Cup and the potential positive impact on the Host Country
  • Passion for football recommended

Requiriments

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Descrição da vaga.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar todo o processo de folha de pagamento, inputs, apuração e lançamentos necessários para o processamento da folha, garantindo a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, previdenciária e fiscal.
  • Calcular, via sistema, salários, encargos sociais e impostos incidentes sobre a folha de pagamento, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos legais de pagamento e recolhimento.
  • Apurar encargos trabalhistas, bem como executar o processo de contabilização, provisão e conciliação da folha de pagamento em conjunto com a área contábil.
  • Apoiar os processos de administração de pessoal, incluindo conferência e importação do ponto para a folha, cálculo e pagamento de férias e rescisões, assegurando conformidade legal e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Apoiar a implantação e estabilização de novos sistemas de folha de pagamento, atuando no mapeamento de processos, testes, validação de dados, homologação de cálculos e suporte à transição, garantindo a continuidade e a acuracidade das rotinas de folha.
  • Acompanhar e dar suporte a colaboradores em processos de transferência internacional, assegurando o correto tratamento da folha, encargos e compliance local e internacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento sólido de sistemas de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico, com habilidade para realizar cálculos complexos e validar integrações entre sistemas.
  • Domínio da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária, com capacidade para interpretar convenções coletivas e aplicar regras em cenários diversos.
  • Familiaridade com obrigações acessórias e ferramentas de controle fiscal, como eSocial.
  • Experiência prévia em sistemas integrados de RH e implementação de sistemas é um diferencial.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura.

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas.

Dica: nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.

Em seguida, vamos adentrar em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás.
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores.
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO.
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Formação acadêmica

Conhecimentos Técnicos desejável

  • Sistemas de utilidades: água gelada, ar comprimido, água potável/quente, utilidades térmicas.

  • Eficiência energética aplicada a sistemas HVAC.
  • Leitura e análise de P&IDs, fluxogramas, layouts e diagramas funcionais .
  • Análise de confiabilidade e suporte a RCA.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Who You Are

For this role, you will need

We recognize the importance of employee well‑being. Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

  • Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade, atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

title: User Operations Intern
description:
If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the team/role

As a User Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support day‑to‑day user service and quality efforts that directly improve ride safety, platform trust, and user retention across millions of trips; your work will drive measurable reductions in issue resolution time and increase user satisfaction scores. You will join the User Operations team, which focuses on resolving rider and driver concerns, enforcing policy, and optimizing operational workflows to protect user experience and enable scalable, reliable service delivery.

In this role, you'll be...

  • User Segmentation Analysis: Assist in segmenting users based on multi‑dimensional data (e.g., New, Active, Churned) and identifying behavioral patterns and pain points.
  • Execution of Messaging Strategies: Responsible for the configuration and execution of in‑app messages, pop‑ups, H5 and out‑of‑app communication tasks such as push, WhatsApp/SMS, email.
  • Copywriting & Localization: Craft compelling marketing copy for different user segments and optimize localized content to boost Click‑Through Rates (CTR).
  • A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization.
  • Tool Management: Operate internal CMS and automated marketing platforms to ensure precise and timely delivery of messages across all user touchpoints.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational Background: Current undergraduate student, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or Statistics.
  • Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for crafting marketing copy; proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
  • Data Sensitivity: A basic understanding of operational metrics (e.g., CTR, Retention) and proficiency in Excel are required. Proficiency in SQL queries is a plus.
  • Work Ethic: Highly detail‑oriented and responsible. Since messaging tasks impact the entire user base, a high level of accuracy is required.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth.

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion.

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

A BIC não está procurando assistência ou aceitando currículos não solicitados de empresas de recrutamento para esta oportunidade de emprego. title: Quality Assurance Tester
description:
Duration - Full time

Salary - Competitive

Job Description

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands‑on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end‑to‑end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands‑on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail‑oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross‑functional teams.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work‑life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future‑oriented sector, contributing to high‑impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

7- Apoiar o tratamento de falhas, inconsistências de dados, divergências de fechamento e desvios de medição, participando da apuração de causas, avaliação de impactos e definição de ações corretivas.

8- Interagir com equipes de operação, engenharia, manutenção, automação, comercialização, contratos e regulação para alinhamento de dados, esclarecimento de divergências e suporte ao processo decisório.

10- Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, qualidade dos dados e aderência de processo, propondo melhorias para aumento da robustez, eficiência e confiabilidade dos controles da disciplina.

11- Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fiscalizações e demandas regulatórias, organizando evidências, dados, histórico de tratativas e documentação técnica necessária.

12- Participar da implementação, sustentação e melhoria contínua de sistemas informacionais de Gestão da Medição e Hydrocarbon Accounting, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos de controle e governança de dados.

13- Comprometer-se com a melhoria contínua do desempenho empresarial, Segurança, Saúde, Meio Ambiente e Sustentabilidade. Agir sempre em conformidade com Sistema de Gestão de SSMS

Graduação em Química ou Engenharias;

Experiência em medição e/ou controle de produção no setor de O&G , com foco em garantir a rastreabilidade e a qualidade dos dados de produção;

title: User Operations Intern
description:
About the Company

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

About the Team / Role

As a User Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support day‑to‑day user service and quality efforts that directly improve ride safety, platform trust, and user retention across millions of trips; your work will drive measurable reductions in issue resolution time and increase user satisfaction scores. You will join the User Operations team, which focuses on resolving rider and driver concerns, enforcing policy, and optimizing operational workflows to protect user experience and enable scalable, reliable service delivery.

In this role, you'll be...

  • User Segmentation Analysis: Assist in segmenting users based on multi‑dimensional data (e.g., New, Active, Churned) and identifying behavioral patterns and pain points.
  • Execution of Messaging Strategies: Responsible for the configuration and execution of in‑app (In‑app messages, Pop‑ups, H5) and out‑of‑app (Push, WhatsApp/SMS, Email) communication tasks.
  • Copywriting & Localization: Craft compelling marketing copy for different user segments and optimize localized content to boost Click‑Through Rates (CTR).
  • A/B Testing Support: Assist in conducting A/B tests for copy and strategies, tracking data performance, and providing insights for future optimization.
  • Tool Management: Operate internal CMS and automated marketing platforms to ensure precise and timely delivery of messages across all user touchpoints.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Educational Background: Current undergraduate student, preferably in Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or Statistics.
  • Logic & Copywriting: Excellent writing skills with the ability to capture user psychology; strong logical thinking and a basic understanding of user segmentation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English and Portuguese (written and verbal) for crafting marketing copy; Proficiency in Chinese is a plus.
  • Data Sensitivity: A basic understanding of operational metrics (e.g., CTR, Retention) and proficiency in Excel are required. Proficiency in SQL queries is a plus.
  • Work Ethic: Highly detail‑oriented and responsible. Since messaging tasks impact the entire user base, a high level of accuracy is required.

You’ll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Here Is What We Offer

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Oversee all laboratory sections, interfacing between faculty and graduate assistants as well as faculty and students.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Serves as liaison between class instructors and students to coordinate all laboratory sessions with topics covered during lecture, and as helper and provider for student projects.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain, organize, and oversee equipment and supplies related to teaching laboratories. Support undergraduate teaching laboratories by ensuring equipment is properly operated and maintained. Ensure that equipment, laboratories, and procedures meet ABET accreditation standards.
  • Train faculty, staff, and students on the safe and correct operation of laboratory equipment.
  • Coordinate with instructors and teaching assistants on the implementation of the laboratory curriculum.
  • Perform and maintain inventory of laboratory supplies and equipment.
  • Assist students and faculty for projects and laboratory activities.
  • Support research, teaching, and co-curricular activities.
  • Implement and enforce safety rules and requirements in coordination with the CEA Safety Officer and other relevant personnel to ensure the safe operation of the laboratory.
  • Maintain laboratory equipment and implement equipment and software upgrades as appropriate.
  • Work with chairs, faculty, and staff as a productive team member.
  • Carry out other assigned duties as designated by the direct supervisor, Department Chair and Associate Dean for Academic Affairs.
  • Interface with the departmental Space and Facilities Committee.
  • Perform other duties as assigned or required.

Core Competencies

  • Computer literacy, including high level of competence in computer network, internet, Wi-Fi, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Email.
  • Competence in oral and written English.
  • Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to process university paperwork efficiently and expeditiously.
  • Ability to establish, maintain and promote harmonious and effective work relationships with students, faculty, staff, University officials, officials of funding agencies and the general public.
  • The incumbent in the position must keep his/her laboratory skills and knowledge up to date through self-education, professional development, and additional courses/workshops as needed and required by the Department Chair and Associate Dean (Academic Affairs).

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related field and minimum of five years of experience working in laboratory settings of general electrical and computer engineering including, but not limited to: electric circuits, electronics, energy and power systems, control systems, digital systems, computer systems, communications, and electromagnetics.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.
Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?

Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café.
Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade. Na JDE Peet’s, trabalhamos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e descubra qual é a sua xícara de momentos incríveis!

Base Brasil (atuação onshore com interface direta com as operações offshore).

A DOF é uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços marítimos e submarinos integrados para o mercado global de energia offshore. Combinamos expertise, ativos e tecnologia para executar operações integradas submersas e offshore de forma segura e confiável — sempre.

Com uma equipe multinacional de aproximadamente 6.000 pessoas e a maior frota mundial de Embarcações de Apoio à Construção (CSVs) e embarcações de alto padrão de Rebocadores de Manuseio de Âncoras (AHTS), apoiamos nossos parceiros com alcance global, escala e capacidade líder no setor. title: Social Media and Webmaster
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Social Media Marketing Specialist & Webmaster is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing the District of Columbia Small Business Development Center’s (DCSBDC) digital communications strategy. This role oversees all social media platforms, website management (DCSBDC.org), digital branding initiatives, online engagement, and marketing campaigns designed to increase program awareness, client participation, and stakeholder engagement. The position also supports marketing strategy, public relations efforts, and digital resource development to enhance DCSBDC’s visibility and impact.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY: N/A

Nature And Scope

This position manages the DCSBDC’s digital presence through social media monitoring, content creation, platform engagement, website maintenance, and online marketing campaigns. The incumbent collaborates with leadership, counselors, clients, and external partners to promote services, events, training programs, and strategic initiatives. The role requires strategic planning, content development, analytics reporting, and execution of integrated marketing efforts aligned with Howard University and SBA guidelines.

Principal Accountabilities

Social Media Strategy & Management:
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive social media content strategy across Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.
  • Create and tailor content specific to each platform to maximize engagement and reach.
  • Manage daily posting schedules and ensure consistent, timely updates.
  • Monitor social media platforms for engagement, inquiries, and spam filtering.
  • Respond to and engage with followers, stakeholders, and community members.
  • Provide monthly social media analytics and performance reports.
  • Use social platforms and groups to increase awareness of DCSBDC programs and services.
Website Management & Digital Content
  • Maintain and update DCSBDC.org to ensure functionality, relevance, and accuracy.
  • Post updates, events, services, and announcements daily or as needed.
  • Contribute to new website content creation, including training videos and resource materials.
  • Maintain and update the client resource database.
  • Create and manage subsites for special initiatives (e.g., Business Development 2.0 Webinar Series).
  • Marketing & Communications
  • Design and produce marketing materials, including digital flyers and social media graphics.
  • Develop and promote webinar series and virtual events.
Pitch Commentary Articles And Content To Media Outlets, Including
  • Washington Informer
  • Afro
  • National Newspaper Publishers Association (NNPA)

Coordinate client news, events, and community involvement stories for publication.

Support public relations and event marketing initiatives.

Conduct weekly conference calls with leadership to assess marketing priorities.

  • VSBDR and Other Special Program Marketing Support
  • Create and implement VSBDR and BCCI social media campaigns.
  • Develop promotional graphics and materials.
  • Promote participation in the VSBDR and BCCI program.
  • Monitor sign-ups and engagement metrics.
  • Enhance program visibility to drive grant applications and resource utilization.
  • Client Engagement & Consulting
Client Engagement & Consulting
  • Work directly with clients (one-on-one or in group settings) to provide guidance in:
  • Social Media Strategy & Execution
  • Branding & Awareness
  • Marketing Strategy Development
  • Refer clients to appropriate DCSBDC services.
  • Provide general analysis and social marketing integration consulting.
Administrative & Collaboration
  • Attend bi-weekly VSBDR regional meetings.
  • Coordinate internal and external digital communications.
  • Support overall marketing, communications, and outreach objectives of the DCSBDC.

Core Competencies

  • Digital Marketing Strategy
  • Social Media Management & Analytics
  • Website Management & Content Development
  • Graphic Design & Branding
  • Public Relations & Media Outreach
  • Marketing Campaign Development
  • Client Engagement & Consulting
  • Strategic Communication
  • Project Management
  • Data Analysis & Reporting

Minimum Requirements

High School Diploma with a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in social media marketing, website management, or digital communications required. Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Information Technology, or related field preferred. Demonstrated experience managing multiple social media platforms and website content management systems. Proficiency in graphic design tools and digital analytics platforms. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$44,000-$54,000

  • 1

  • 2
  • Receive and store stock, (including bunkering of chemicals) as required.
  • 3
  • Optimize stock usage to always maintain levels.
  • 4
  • Issue stock / ensure that adequate levels are available for other users.
  • 5) Communicate Information (Written And Orally), Accurately, Concisely And Promptly
  • 1
  • Process incoming and outgoing communications.

  • 3

  • 3

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você irá cuidar das crianças, dos espaços e materiais, e também auxiliar o(a) professor(a) em suas atribuições e rotina.

O que você fará:

  • Acolher e acompanhar a rotina das crianças;
  • Observar crianças e interagir em atividades do dia a dia;
  • Zelar pela boa organização do espaço;
  • Orientar as crianças a manterem uma relação respeitosa e colaborativa entre elas;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Salvaguardar nossas crianças e jovens.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em andamento ou completa de Pedagogia ou Psicologia;
  • Boa compreensão do ambiente escolar;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Nossos auxiliares de professor devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Experiência no segmento da vaga.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. We are seeking a professional for the Materials Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

This position is responsible for acting as the Technical Authority to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests, ensuring technical integrity and compliance with MODEC standards for Materials Engineer discipline. Also r esponsible for leading the team that will be conducting Root Cause Analyses (RCA) in accordance with MODEC guidelines to identify and address the underlying causes of technical issues for Materials Engineer discipline.

Responsibilities and assignments

To perform functions such as:

  • Technical Authority for the evaluation and response to MOC and TA requests, ensuring all technical solutions are compliant with MODEC standards and industry regulations.
  • Review, assess, and approve technical changes, modifications, and deviations, providing clear recommendations and justifications.
  • Perform Root Cause Analyses (RCA) for incidents, failures, and recurring issues, ensuring thorough investigation and documentation in line with MODEC procedures.
  • Develop and communicate technical reports and recommendations based on RCA findings to prevent recurrence and improve operational reliability.
  • Ensure all technical evaluations and recommendations are properly documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders, including offshore and onshore teams.
  • Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions resulting from MOC, TA, and RCA processes, monitoring their effectiveness.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of MODEC guidelines, industry standards, and best practices to ensure technical solutions are current and effective.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to operations, maintenance, and engineering teams as required.
  • Participate in audits, reviews, and technical meetings to ensure continuous improvement and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in offshore visits as required to support technical evaluations, investigations, and implementation of solutions.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree of Engineering is required.
  • MBA is a competitive edge.
  • Active CREA registration.
  • Overall experience is expected.
  • Experience in Offshore/Onshore Production Process on Oil & Gas is expected.
  • Fluent English is required.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office package knowledge is required.
  • Basic CMMS systems knowledge is a competitive edge (SAP preferred).
  • Basic Power BI knowledge is a competitive edge.

Additional information

Being part of MODEC means being the PROTAGONIST of a CHALLENGING career and being in touch with the latest deep-water production systems, knowing that your career begins in BRAZIL, but your talent can take you anywhere in the WORLD.

- If you want to be one of the greatest in the market, this is your opportunity!!

- As a MULTICULTURAL company that respects DIVERSITY, we encourage PWD application in our process.

Career without borders

At MODEC, our greatest asset is our people. With more than 55 years of history and two decades operating in Brazil, we are a global company in constant growth, present on five continents and a reference in the construction, chartering, and operation of offshore platforms.

In Brazil, we operate 14 production units and have two under construction, bringing together more than 3,300 professionals who build, every day, a safer, more sustainable, and more innovative future.

Here, we value diversity, inclusion, and continuous development. Our environment is collaborative and multicultural, guided by a purpose: to unite people and technologies to transform energy into opportunities.
