title: Service Engineer
description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for meeting the daily maintenance and repair needs of customer equipment. They must establish and maintain appropriate business relationships with customers and colleagues, as well as perform necessary administrative activities and other assigned functions.

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Onboard Service Execution

  • Provide support, supervise, and test/troubleshoot field issues onboard vessels and various offshore units. This includes sailing/staying onboard vessels/units while handling services and warranty-related matters.
  • Execute the requested service in the best possible way to meet customer deadlines and expectations.

Commissioning and On-site Sea Trial Execution

  • Test, calibrate, and verify the system configuration within Emerson ICMS software and other ICMS supplies and Emerson marine products.
  • Deliver and obtain approvals from the Shipyard, Owner, and Class during sea trials.

Reports / Administrative Activities

  • Clearly written work reports must be completed upon returning from trips, in English, detailing all follow-up points.
  • Onboard service reports must be signed by customers.
  • Stay up to date on administrative responsibilities such as maintaining internal service reports and internal records in a timely manner.

Participation in FAT Tests

  • Participate in customer equipment workshop tests, together with project engineering, the end customer, and Class.

Training

  • Participate in all trainings and meetings as required by Emerson.
  • Participate in, observe, and comply with the company’s health and safety guidelines and contribute to a safe work environment.
  • Attend local trainings in the workshop/laboratory/classroom in Denmark and other locations as needed to obtain product updates.
  • Provide basic on-site/onboard training for customers/crews.

Who You Are

You use customer insights to guide and direct the development of new offerings. You go beyond the obvious and do not stop at the first answers. You anticipate conflicts before they happen, based on your understanding of interpersonal and group dynamics. You act quickly and decisively in unpredictable and fast-changing situations. You take consistent action to develop new skills.

For this role, you will need

  • Electrical/Mechanical education with strong knowledge of software and hardware. Additional certifications or training in maintenance, repair, or technical fields related to marine equipment are a plus.
  • 3 years of experience in a similar role, with hands‑on troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of complex technical equipment or systems. Ability to work in a global environment.
  • Experience dealing with customers in high‑pressure environments.
  • Availability to work overtime, as needed.
  • Computer literacy and experience with MS Office and Excel.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Work location: Rio de Janeiro.

Our Culture and Commitment to You

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We promote an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives, because we know great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to continuous career development and fostering an inclusive culture ensures that you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe that diverse teams, working together, are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee well‑being. We offer medical, dental, pharmacy, and Wellhub (Gympass) benefits; life insurance; credit union; private pension plan; recognition programs, and much more. Our people‑focused culture includes resource groups and an employee assistance program, as well as extended parental leave (both maternal and paternal) as part of our Empresa Cidadã certification.

Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Desta forma, as soluções customizadas de Autoprodução de energia Solar, Eficiência Energética, Subestações, HVAC, Geração de vapor, Consultoria e Gerenciamento de Energia atendem toda a cadeia otimizando a relação com a energia em diversos setores como Indústria, Shopping Centers, Varejo Multisites, Aeroportos, Hospitais, entre outros.

Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.

Com esta nova relação com a energia, mais otimizada e inteligente, a ENGIE é a líder mundial em transição energética, assumindo um importante papel neste cenário.

A ENGIE tem a responsabilidade constante na criação de um futuro harmonioso em conjunto com a população, gestores públicos e parceiros, rumo a uma economia neutra em emissões de carbono.

Missão do Cargo

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

Principais Atividades

  1. Identificar e avaliar riscos operacionais, financeiros e de conformidade associados às atividades da empresa de energia renovável.
  2. Executar auditorias internas periódicas para avaliar a eficácia dos controles internos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  3. Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações do setor, garantindo aderência aos controles internos.
  4. Fornecer treinamento e orientação aos colaboradores sobre práticas e controles internos, fomentando cultura de conformidade.
  5. Desenvolver protocolos para tratamento de incidentes de não conformidade, investigando irregularidades e definindo medidas corretivas.
  6. Preparar relatórios regulares sobre desempenho dos controles internos, com análises e recomendações à alta administração.
  7. Colaborar com TI para integrar controles internos aos sistemas corporativos, promovendo abordagem sistêmica.
  8. Avaliar eficiência e eficácia dos processos de negócio, propondo melhorias para otimização e redução de riscos.
  9. Facilitar auditorias externas, garantindo fornecimento de documentação e informações necessárias.
  10. Efetuar os testes e análises de acordo com as instruções do Grupo para o programa global de controles internos.

Requisitos

  • Superior completo: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado;
  • Pacote office Intermediário.
  • Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA) Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office – Avançado
  • Conhecimento em processos de controles internos
  • Experiência em Big 4

Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Brasil

title: Treasury Analyst

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Treasury Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of Carta’s Fund Administration business supporting a global FA Treasury team—owning daily operational processes while driving improvements that enhance the overall client experience. Beyond executing payments and managing bank administration tasks, you’ll collaborate cross‑functionally to identify inefficiencies, contribute to scalable solutions, and help shape how we support fund operations at scale.

  • Own end‑to‑end payment execution workflows, including initiating and reviewing ACH / Wire and FX payments for client approval
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams such as Product, Engineering and Operations to troubleshoot issues, improve processes, and influence product roadmaps
  • Communicate with clients and external stakeholders to address inquiries and provide a high‑quality support experience
  • Lead or support the opening and setup of new client bank accounts in partnership with Onboarding and Implementation teams
  • Establish and maintain bank connectivity, ensuring transactions are accurately uploaded to the Carta platform
  • Proactively identify operational gaps, risks and support the development of scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of internal reporting, documentation, playbooks, and training resources
  • Support data analysis and reporting needs using Excel, Metabase, Looker and other internal data tools
  • Verify vendor / payee wire instructions, collect necessary documentation (e.g., W‑9s), and ensure compliance with internal controls

The Impact You’ll Have

At Carta, we’re building infrastructure that helps innovators unlock the power of ownership. On the Treasury team, you'll be at the center of that mission—ensuring our clients’ capital flows reliably and efficiently. You'll work closely with the Fund Administration team to help with the day‑to‑day payment processing requests and bank administration tasks on behalf of fund administration clients. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring accurate and timely fund movements for our clients. Your contributions will help improve and scale our Treasury processes, while giving you the opportunity to grow cross‑functionally and influence how we support fund operations at Carta.

About You

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written
  • 2–3 years of experience in Treasury, banking operations, or payment processing, with an interest in growing into more strategic or technical roles
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of ownership over assigned workflows
  • Clear verbal and written communicator who is comfortable interacting directly with clients and cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Proficient in Excel and adaptable to learning tools like Looker, Salesforce, or other internal platforms
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking thoughtful questions, and proposing ideas for process improvement
  • Intellectual curiosity with a strong appetite for continuous learning and growth
  • Strong problem‑solving and critical thinking skills; naturally curious and solution‑oriented
  • Interested in building a long‑term career in Treasury, Fund Administration, or fintech operations
  • Understanding of Fund Administration is a plus

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Software Developer (Web) calls for a talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product. You will have an opportunity to apply your versatile web, cloud, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will collaborate with other engineers while contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - Rio de Janeiro

Please submit your résumé/CV in English.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor’s degre
  • Advanced English
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Experience in User Experience (UX) design and interaction design
  • Proficiency with REACT for frontend development
  • Experience in backend development using Kotlin and Java
  • Experience with web technologies, such as CSS, HTML5, JavaScript, JSON, REST, AJAX, XML,HTTP
  • Experience establishing and maintaining design standards and patterns for product areas assigned
  • Experience in creating conceptual models, use cases/scenarios, personas, wireframes, mock-ups, user flow diagrams, prototypes, product roadmaps, style guides, and specification documents as part of a comprehensive design strategy Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes

Nice to have

  • Experience defining success metrics with cross-functional teams to measure success of UX initiatives
  • Knowledge of C# and C++ is a plus
  • Working knowledge of backend frameworks such as Spring Boot / Node.js is a plus
  • Knowledge of JIRA/Confluence
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)

Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, sexual orientations, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Base Finanças, não entregamos relatórios — estruturamos a inteligência financeira que sustenta decisões de C-level. Como Especialista de Controladoria, você vai trabalhar diretamente com os sócios na condução de projetos financeiros de alta complexidade para pequenas e médias empresas, atuando na fronteira entre finanças, tecnologia e estratégia.

Aqui, a sua responsabilidade é real desde o primeiro dia. Você não vai esperar aprovação para pensar: vai ser a pessoa que valida premissas, desafia modelos e constrói a visão financeira que os nossos clientes precisam para tomar melhores decisões.

Você vai:

  • Implementar e gerir modelos de gestão econômica que dão visibilidade real à performance dos clientes;
  • Estruturar e analisar o Fluxo de Caixa Indireto como ferramenta de diagnóstico, conectando lucro contábil à capacidade de reinvestimento;

Buscamos pessoas com pensamento crítico aguçado, perfil consultivo e senioridade para transitar com naturalidade entre diferentes ERPs, modelos de negócio e interlocutores. Valorizamos quem enxerga o negócio por trás dos números e tem disposição para propor melhorias estruturais, não apenas executar o que foi pedido.

Domínio avançado de Excel, Power Query e Power BI é essencial. Conhecimento sólido em contabilidade gerencial e regime de competência também. Aqui, o seu crescimento é proporcional à qualidade das suas entregas e ao impacto que você gera.

Se você quer trabalhar em projetos que realmente movem empresas, com responsabilidade real, exposição direta e ambiente que valoriza integridade técnica, a Base pode ser o lugar certo para você.

Remuneração compatível com o mercado + remuneração variável semestral Programa de partnership estruturado Vale Alimentação + Vale Transporte no Cartão iFood de Benefícios Flexíveis Modelo Híbrido com escritório em Botafogo

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:

  • Implementar e gerir modelos de gestão econômica, garantindo visibilidade real da performance financeira dos clientes;
  • Estruturar o Fluxo de Caixa Indireto como ferramenta de conciliação e diagnóstico, conectando resultado contábil à capacidade de reinvestimento;
  • Mapear e otimizar ciclos financeiros, convertendo faturamento em liquidez e identificando alavancas de eficiência no Capital de Giro;
  • Liderar a construção de KPIs e dashboards em Power BI, garantindo que a informação seja canônica, rastreável e auditável;

O que esperamos:

  • Experiência sólida em controladoria gerencial e contabilidade gerencial;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel, Power Query e Power BI;
  • Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de interlocução com fundadores e alta liderança;
  • Autonomia para atuar em ambientes complexos, com diferentes ERPs e modelos de negócio;
  • Pensamento crítico para enxergar o negócio por trás dos números e propor melhorias estruturais.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência prévia em consultoria financeira ou assessoria a PMEs;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Economia ou áreas afins;

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Sobre a PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visam diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
Descrição do cargo

Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de instalações, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do contrato; executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos (aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, back lights, postes de iluminação, boilers, bombas hidráulicas, tele tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc.), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra‑estrutura do contrato; executar a manutenção preventiva de quadros elétricos de baixa tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica por aparelho multiteste, limpando componentes com produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra‑estrutura do contrato; description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional qualificado para atuar como Eletricista , responsável pela instalação, manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas elétricos prediais e equipamentos. Atuará garantindo o funcionamento seguro e eficiente da rede elétrica, atendendo às normas técnicas e de segurança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar instalações elétricas de baixa tensão em ambientes internos e externos;
  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em circuitos, quadros de energia, tomadas, interruptores, luminárias e disjuntores;
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas em sistemas elétricos;
  • Conserto de bombas;
  • Fazer leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos e esquemas técnicos;
  • Instalar e substituir componentes elétricos, como sensores, relés, cabos, eletrodutos e dispositivos de proteção;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho e uso adequado de EPIs;
  • Atuar em conjunto com equipes de manutenção predial, hidráulica e civil;
  • Manter o ambiente de trabalho limpo, organizado e seguro.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso profissionalizante de Eletricista (com certificado);
  • Experiência comprovada na função;
  • Conhecimento em instalação e manutenção elétrica predial;
  • Habilidade para leitura de projetos elétricos e diagramas unifilares;
  • Certificação NR-10 atualizada (obrigatória);
  • NR-35 (trabalho em altura) será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Hard Skills – Desejáveis

  • Instalações e manutenções elétricas em baixa tensão;
  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos e projetos técnicos;
  • Manuseio de ferramentas específicas (alicate amperímetro, multímetro etc.);
  • Montagem de quadros de distribuição elétrica;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de iluminação, aterramento e proteção contra surtos;
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas e procedimentos de segurança (NR-10, NBR 5410, etc.).

Soft Skills – Desejáveis

  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em segurança;
  • Organização e disciplina;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Proatividade para identificação e solução de problemas.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Fisia , a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil.

Integramos o ecossistema do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas.

Somos guardiões de uma marca que está presente no dia a dia de milhões de pessoas no mundo todo. Nos primeiros passos no esporte, na velocidade das pistas de corrida, nas manobras de skate, na agilidade das chuteiras em campo, no lifestyle de quem se veste de esporte dos pés à cabeça.

Contamos com um time de mais de 1.000 colaboradores, que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam não apenas uma marca, mas o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e paixão pelo esporte.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sobre a posição no jogo:

A pessoa que ocupa a função de Assistente de Loja é a peça chave do nosso time, pois o campo tem que estar organizado para o jogo acontecer! É a pessoa que vai encantar o nosso cliente e garantir uma experiência inesquecível em nossa loja.

Essa pessoa é responsável por:

  • Participar do recebimento e processamento de produtos no estoque;
  • Organizar a loja, fazer a reposição de produtos e manutenção da área de vendas;
  • Realizar atendimento proativo e esclarecer dúvidas sobre produtos;
  • Manter o engajamento das vendas digitais e outros serviços;
  • Operar o caixa e garantir a melhor experiência para o nosso consumidor.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Talento para atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade com organização e reposição de produtos;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Vontade de aprender e de crescer.

SOBRE NÓS

Nascemos em dezembro de 2020, e somos a distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil.

Integramos o ecossistema de esportes do Grupo SBF e acreditamos no poder transformador que o esporte tem na vida das pessoas. Nossa identidade foi construída nas últimas duas décadas - período em que fomos os representantes da marca no país.

Nosso dia a dia é repleto de movimento e inspiração. Somos responsáveis por trazer inovações aos consumidores brasileiros, conectá-los a marca mais admirada do mundo e manter a paixão pela prática esportiva acesa todos os dias.

Contamos com um time forte em campo, com 46 lojas, somamos mais de 1.000 colaboradores que vestem a camisa com orgulho e representam o compromisso de transformar a vida dos brasileiros por meio da alegria e pelo esporte.

A temporada de contratações está aberta, e o seu nome pode estar em nossa escalação.

É apaixonado(a) por esporte e quer contribuir para transformar esse mercado no Brasil? Venha fazer parte do nosso ecossistema!

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer’s disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

title: Operations
description:
Overview

An Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that a team’s day-to-day activities run smoothly and align with the organization’s strategic objectives. This position is responsible for overseeing operational processes , ensuring that resources—such as personnel, budgets, equipment, and time—are used as efficiently and effectively as possible. By setting and maintaining high company standards , an Operations Manager works to consistently exceed objectives, improve productivity, and foster a culture of excellence. The role often requires coordinating between frontline employees and senior leadership , serving as a critical link to ensure that communication flows clearly in both directions. This includes translating high-level business goals into practical, actionable plans for teams, as well as escalating operational challenges to upper management when needed. Typical duties may involve developing and optimizing workflows , managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing process improvements to boost efficiency and quality. An Operations Manager also plays an active role in problem-solving , anticipating risks, and addressing issues before they escalate, ensuring smooth operations even under tight deadlines or high-pressure situations. In addition, this role often includes training, mentoring, and performance evaluation to help employees prioritize tasks, meet individual and team goals, and contribute to a positive, high-performance workplace culture. Success as an Operations Manager requires a balance of strategic thinking, strong leadership, adaptability, and excellent organizational skills , along with the ability to make data-driven decisions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee operational processes and ensure resources (personnel, budgets, equipment, and time) are used efficiently and effectively.
  • Coordinate between frontline employees and senior leadership; translate high-level business goals into practical, actionable plans; escalate operational challenges to upper management as needed.
  • Develop and optimize workflows; manage budgets; monitor performance metrics; implement process improvements to boost efficiency and quality.
  • Engage in problem-solving, anticipate risks, and address issues before they escalate to maintain smooth operations under tight deadlines or high-pressure situations.
  • Provide training, mentoring, and performance evaluation to help employees prioritize tasks, meet goals, and contribute to a positive, high-performance workplace culture.
  • Apply strategic thinking, leadership, adaptability, and strong organizational skills to make data-driven decisions that drive growth and operational excellence.

Essa vaga é para você, que é apaixonado em fazer a diferença, liderar, que gosta de desafios e resolver problemas de forma rápida e efetiva.

Seu lugar é aqui!

Como será seu dia a dia?

Seu papel é liderar a sua equipe, na busca dos melhores resultados, atuando no dia a dia, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas em cima dos desafios regionais e plano comercial!

  • Boa fluência verbal para contato com clientes e outras áreas da empresa;
  • Pensamento criativo voltado à diversidade e mindset de crescimento;
  • Facilidade para trabalho em equipe;

  • Experiência com vendas ;
  • Será um diferencial ter experiência com PAP;

Residir nas regiões:

  • Rio de Janeiro - Araruama, Angra dos Reis, Barra do Piraí, Barra Mansa, Iguaba Grande, Itaperuna, Niterói, Petrópolis, Rio Bonito, Rio das Ostras, Rio de Janeiro, São Pedro da Aldeia, Teresópolis, Mangaratiba, Resende e Volta Redonda.

Horário de Trabalho

Segunda a sexta das 09hrs às 18hrse aos sábados das 09hrs às 13hrs - possibilidade de atuação em horário alternativo no sábado para ações externas

Muito prazer, somos a Atento!

Aqui no Grupo Atento – formado também pela empresa Interfile – acreditamos que a melhor experiência do cliente começa com o respeito e cuidado com as pessoas . E isso vale para todo mundo que faz parte da nossa companhia! Se você está em busca da sua primeira oportunidade , ou já tem uma bagagem profissional incrível , o nosso convite é o mesmo: vem crescer com a gente!

A Atento é uma das cinco maiores empresas do mundo em serviços de relacionamento com o cliente e terceirização de processos (CRM/BPO) – e a líder absoluta na América Latina ! Estamos em 17 países , com mais de 95 centros de relacionamento e 110 mil postos de trabalho . Atendemos mais de 400 clientes , muitas delas gigantes globais nas áreas de tecnologia, telecom, finanças, saúde, varejo e muito mais.

Juntar tecnologia + humanização para criar conexões reais e experiências inesquecíveis entre marcas e consumidores. A cada interação, queremos fazer a diferença – enriquecendo vidas e gerando valor para os negócios dos nossos clientes.

Nossa cultura tem nome: One Atento

"One Atento" é a forma que temos de fazer as coisas por aqui – com propósito, união e um olhar sempre voltado para o futuro. São seis valores que nos guiam todos os dias:parceiros estratégicos ,cuidamos das nossas pessoas ,em equipe vencemos ,ágil e simples ,mente aberta eentrega de resultados .

O que faz um vendedor PaP?

O vendedor PaP também conhecido como vendedor externo, faz a prospecção de clientes através de visitas presenciais definidas por rotas ou ações externas, garantindo qualidade de entrega de resultados de vendas.

O que faz um supervisor Pap?

Seu papel é liderar a equipe na busca dos melhores resultados, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas em cima dos desafios regionais e plano comercial!

Temos oportunidades em todos os estados do Brasil.

Quais os requisitos mínimos para concorrer à vaga?

Para vendedor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino fundamental completo e experiência com vendas (de qualquer modalidade).

Para supervisor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino médio completo, experiência com vendas e liderança, CNH e veículo próprio.

Como é o processo seletivo?

Você fará seu cadastro, participará de uma entrevista com o RH e depois com o requisitante.

Processo simples e rápido! #VemserAtento!

Quais os benefícios?

Acesse a vaga da sua região e verifique as informações de salário, comissão e benefícios!#TransparêncianoProcesso!

Conheça também os nossos outros Portais de Carreiras:

Interfile – com vagas voltadas para soluções de backoffice e gestão de processos;

Portal PcD – com vagas exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência.

Esclarecemos que nenhum valor é cobrado para que você participe dos nossos processos seletivos. Caso seja solicitado a você qualquer pagamento em troca de apostilas, treinamentos ou até mesmo inscrição nas nossas vagas, fique alerta e faça um Boletim de Ocorrência na delegacia mais próxima. Nenhuma companhia, seja ela nossa parceira ou não, possui permissão para exigir pagamentos em nome da Atento. Oferecemos também o canal para denúncias em caso de recebimento de mensagens inadequadas ou impróprias.

title: Sales Representative - Brazil
description:
Sales Representative - Brazil (100% Remote)

Do you want to dive in the fast-growing industry of drones and get a rewarding experience in a dynamic scale-up environment?

At Flyability, we believe that robots should be sent into hazardous places and dangerous situations instead of humans. To support our belief, we created Elios, the world’s first collision-tolerant flying robot that for the first time allows remote entry to complex and indoor spaces. With more than 100 employees, Flyability is the pioneer in the UAV indoor inspection industry. Joining Flyability is not just taking on a new job, it is seizing the opportunity to improve the life of millions of people and build the future of robotics.

Location: Must be based in Rio de Janeiro

Starting date: as soon as possible

Your role:

We are looking for a Sales Representative to join our Sales team. In this role, you will be reporting to the Managing Director for the Americas, based at the company headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland.

On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with new customers to identify product fit and close deals. You will collaborate with our distribution partners in your area to ensure that opportunities are progressing and that they are receiving the support they need from us. You will also frequently meet with accounts in your territory to ensure their satisfaction and help them scale their use of our technology.

This role will own all commercial activities for Brazil. We are therefore looking for someone who can work independently and proactively, build and grow relationships with customers and partners, and quickly learn the needs of various industries to identify and deliver added value.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the sales objectives and growth strategy in your assigned territory
  • Build and maintain leads and opportunities pipelines for direct and indirect sales
  • Travel to industrial sites across South America (with a strong emphasis on Brazil) for meetings, demonstrations, or proof of concepts. Work on industrial sites may include operating the drone in-asset, which could imply working at heights or in hazardous environments
  • Build relationships with local key accounts with periodic discussions and ensure they scale to their full potential
  • Manage and develop a network of channel partners
  • Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound campaigns and events in coordination with the marketing team
  • Assist in organizing and executing multiple trade shows and roadshows
  • Assist with various sales projects, support or logistical issues as needed

Your profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher and/or equivalent experience required
  • At least 3 years of sales experience in industrial products or related complex commercial product sales
  • Ability to communicate proficiently in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a strong-added asset
  • Experience with direct B2B sales
  • Excellent written, verbal and public speaking skills
  • Proven track record of selling large contracts to companies or government agencies
  • Ability to load, unload, set up equipment weighing 50–70 pounds
  • Ability to work on industrial sites, which may require climbing multiple flights of stairs
  • Ability to work in Brazil and drive a vehicle
  • Ability to travel up to 70% of the time, nationally and internationally
  • Ability to quickly learn needs and processes in various industries
  • Proactivity, integrity, and the ability to work in an international team
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Experience in hardware and software sales (B2B) is a plus
  • Experience with UAVs, ROVs or other robotics solutions is a plus

Flyability is a young Swiss company that values independent thinking combined with a collaborative spirit. Every day, you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and contribute to solving problems. We all work together, and each voice is important to move forward

Ready to join?

We know the confidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply - regardless of your experience or resume, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive based salary and commission structure
  • Uncapped commission scheme for over-performance
  • Annual trip to Switzerland
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. BuscamosFisioterapeutas Visitadores apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Porporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo o seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo a segurança e a integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando eventuais problemas de saúde relacionados a mobilidade humana. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos, desempenha um papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequadas e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para o envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidar, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com Empatia e Carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da Assistência em Fisioterapia, por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido.

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the- ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network.

Qima’s industry-leading experts for onsite inspections, supplier audits, and lab testing are supported by a digital platform that provides accuracy, transparency, and intelligence for quality and compliance data. Our culture is unique, with our 5,000 Qimates making decisions every day based on our Qima Values.

Job Description

Help us drive the adoption and delivery of innovative digital solutions that improve efficiency, client experience, and compliance across the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for a Digital Project Manager who can coordinate cross-regional initiatives, support client onboarding, and ensure successful implementation of digital tools across operations.

This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and client engagement, helping translate business needs into effective digital solutions while ensuring strong adoption across regions.

Key Missions

Digital Project Delivery : Lead the execution of digital initiatives from planning to rollout. Coordinate with product, engineering, QA, and business teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and aligned with operational needs.

Client Onboarding & Adoption: Support the onboarding of internal teams and external clients to new digital tools and platforms. Monitor adoption, identify barriers to usage, and work with stakeholders to improve engagement and value realization.

Cross-Regional Coordination : Act as the key point of coordination between regional teams in Latin America and global teams in Asia and Europe. Ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and implementation strategies.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Planejar e programar as ordens de serviço de manutenção eletromecânica, considerando manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, conforme criticidade dos ativos.
  • Dimensionar horas de manutenção (HH), avaliando capacidade da equipe e reservando margem para atendimentos corretivos.
  • Verificar e assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos necessários à execução das ordens de serviço (mão de obra, materiais, ferramentas e terceiros).
  • Controlar prazos, escopos e execução das atividades, garantindo aderência ao planejamento técnico.
  • Monitorar indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog, cumprimento de planos e custos por OS).
  • Analisar falhas recorrentes e históricos de manutenção, propondo melhorias nos planos e processos.
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Atuar como interface entre manutenção, operação, engenharia e suprimentos.
  • Apoiar auditorias por meio da organização e controle da documentação técnica e histórico de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência com gestão de ordens de serviço, backlog e priorização de atividades.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or Product Owner in data, IT, or digital transformation contexts;

  • Experience writing detailed functional specifications , user stories , process diagrams , and acceptance criteria ;
  • Understanding of data modeling concepts , ETL pipelines , and BI/reporting workflows ;

  • Collaborative approach in team settings spanning technical and business disciplines;

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries;

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and remote team environment .

  • Financial & Growth: Competitive salary, a fair commission system, and a professional development budget.
  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical and dental insurance coverage. We also provide Life Insurance for added security.

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

As a Treasury Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of Carta’s Fund Administration business supporting a global FA Treasury team—owning daily operational processes while driving improvements that enhance the overall client experience. Beyond executing payments and managing bank administration tasks, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally to identify inefficiencies, contribute to scalable solutions, and help shape how we support fund operations at scale.

  • Own end-to-end payment execution workflows, including initiating and reviewing ACH / Wire and FX payments for client approval
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering and Operations to troubleshoot issues, improve processes, and influence product roadmaps
  • Communicate with clients and external stakeholders to address inquiries and provide a high-quality support experience
  • Lead or support the opening and setup of new client bank accounts in partnership with Onboarding and Implementation teams
  • Establish and maintain bank connectivity, ensuring transactions are accurately uploaded to the Carta platform
  • Proactively identify operational gaps, risks and support the development of scalable solutions
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of internal reporting, documentation, playbooks, and training resources
  • Support data analysis and reporting needs using Excel, Metabase, Looker and other internal data tools
  • Verify vendor / payee wire instructions, collect necessary documentation (e.g., W-9s), and ensure compliance with internal controls

The Impact You'll Have

At Carta, we’re building infrastructure that helps innovators unlock the power of ownership. On the Treasury team, you'll be at the center of that mission—ensuring our clients' capital flows reliably and efficiently. You'll work closely with the Fund Administration team to help with the day-to-day payment processing requests and bank administration tasks on behalf of fund administration clients. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring accurate and timely fund movements for our clients. Your contributions will help improve and scale our Treasury processes, while giving you the opportunity to grow cross-functionally and influence how we support fund operations at Carta.

About You

  • Fluency in English, both verbal and written
  • 2–3 years of experience in Treasury, banking operations, or payment processing, with an interest in growing into more strategic or technical roles
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of ownership over assigned workflows
  • Clear verbal and written communicator who is comfortable interacting directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Proficient in Excel and adaptable to learning tools like Looker, Salesforce, or other internal platforms
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking thoughtful questions, and proposing ideas for process improvement
  • Intellectual curiosity with a strong appetite for continuous learning and growth
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; naturally curious and solution-oriented
  • Interested in building a long-term career in Treasury, Fund Administration, or fintech operations
  • Understanding of Fund Administration is a plus

title: Instrument Technician
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long‑term, asset‑backed business model that delivers high‑availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower‑carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Reports To

Instrument Supervisor

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

The Instrument Technician is authorized to maintain Instrument assets and systems safely.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives

Responsibilities & Standards

  1. Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment
    • Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
    • Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
    • Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
    • Identify, check and prepare components.
    • Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  2. Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment
    • Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
    • Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
    • Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  3. Diagnose Faults in Equipment
    • Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
    • Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
    • Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on equipment.
    • Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
    • Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  4. Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures
    • Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
    • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
    • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
    • Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  5. Emergency Response
    • Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
    • Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Functional Competencies

  • Offshore – Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIDs
  • Offshore – Handover
  • Offshore – Diagnosis and Fault Finding
  • Offshore – Reports
  • Offshore – Computerised Maintenance Management System
  • Offshore – Planning Work
  • Offshore – Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
  • Offshore – Hazardous Area Classification
  • Offshore – Safety Management

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • COMP X’ course preferred.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at . The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Knowledge Management Technical Author
description:
Overview

Would you thrive in a role where technical communication, knowledge structuring and collaboration are essential to enabling engineering excellence? Would you enjoy transforming complex technical information into accessible, clear and high‑quality documentation that supports teams across a global organization? Join our Knowledge Management Team! At Baker Hughes, Knowledge Management (KM) is essential for accelerating learning, promoting collaboration, and ensuring that expertise is captured and shared across the organization. Our KM team drives digital collaboration tools, documentation excellence, and user‑centric solutions that support engineering, technology and business functions.

Responsibilities

Technical Writing & Content Development:

  • Researching and gathering knowledge from engineers and technical specialists to understand complex products, processes and systems.
  • Reviewing, editing and simplifying existing documents to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity.
  • Creating diagrams, illustrations, screenshots and other visuals to support engineering explanations.

Knowledge Management & Content Governance:

  • Updating and maintaining libraries of technical information within CMS platforms and KM repositories.
  • Ensuring documentation aligned with Baker Hughes standards remains up‑to‑date, correct and consistent.
  • Supporting implementation of KM methodologies, continuous improvement and Lean practices.
  • Identifying and eliminating roadblocks to knowledge sharing while promoting best practices.

SharePoint & Digital Collaboration:

  • Creating, managing and updating SharePoint content, pages, templates and tools used across FPS.
  • Supporting system efficiency through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinating upgrades, improvements and fixes within the KM environment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Consulting:

  • Meeting with teams to develop documentation, templates and SharePoint content aligned with business needs.
  • Reviewing new materials with users and experts to ensure relevance and quality.
  • Partnering closely with FPS Chief Engineers’ Office and global KM teams.
  • Advising on document formatting, intellectual property, branding, confidentiality classifications and export control requirements.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • Have fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Have proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Author or similar documentation‑focused role.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge Management principles and methodologies.
  • Have proficiency in MS Office and adaptability to digital tools used for documentation and collaboration.
  • Have experience with SharePoint (coding knowledge is beneficial but not required).
  • Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry or an equivalent technical sector.
  • Have excellent written communication skills with strong attention to detail and clarity.
  • Have the ability to learn complex technical topics and participate in technical discussions.
  • Have the ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Have familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE).
  • Have an understanding of the Engineering Lifecycle.
  • Willingness to travel internationally if required (desirable).
  • Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable).

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from 7am-4pm or 8am-5pm.
  • Location: RETIC, Ilha do Fundão, Rio de Janeiro.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

title: Communications Specialist, Brazil
description:
Overview

350.org is looking for a Communications Specialist to drive 350.org’s effort to rebuild its public relevance and narrative leadership within Brazil.

About 350.org

350’s mission is to keep carbon in our atmosphere to a safe level, below 350 parts per million. We do this by mobilizing ordinary people to campaign for universal access to clean energy and an end to fossil fuels. Our campaigns are rooted in local organizing, so that while achieving measurable reductions in fossil fuel emissions we also build the power and potential of the climate movement for yet more impact to come. The values that guide and drive our work are listed here.

350.org is an equal opportunity employer. 350.org strives to be an inclusive and collaborative group of people who bring a variety of approaches to the work we do. We’re committed to the principles of justice, and we try to build a safe workplace where everyone is treated fairly and enjoys working together. We value new perspectives, ideas of all sorts, and different ways of working. Diverse perspectives and experiences improve the way 350.org carries out our work – including what we decide to work on and how creatively/effectively we do that. We do our best to make staff positions accessible to all potential team members, regardless of race, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, assigned gender, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or identity, religion or creed, veteran status, marital or parental status, and genetic information. We also strive to include team members in communities most impacted by climate change or impacted by other kinds of environmental, social, and economic injustice.

We strongly encourage applications from non-white people, women, LGBTQIAPN+ people, Indigenous people, Quilombola people, migrants, and other groups affected by violence or oppression, or who do not see themselves represented in professional, institutional, and decision-making spaces.

About Communications Specialist, Brazil

The Communications Specialist will drive 350.org’s effort to rebuild its public relevance and narrative leadership within Brazil in an era of shrinking civic space, social media volatility, and declining climate attention. The role exists to make 350’s voice impossible to ignore — bold, creative, trusted and emotionally resonant. We aim to reposition 350 with Brazil audiences as a global campaigning force that inspires participation, drives cultural relevance, and grows the movement’s reach and influence.

Duties and Responsibilities

Communication and Social Media:

  • Develop and implement media strategy, supporting the plans and outputs for 350 Brasil campaigns under the guidance of Brazil Country Manager and in collaboration with central teams when relevant
  • Develop and implement a 350 Brasil social media engagement strategy aligned with campaign goals, under the guidance of Brazil Country Manager and in coordination with central Communications Team
  • Identify external events and media opportunities, and plan and coordinate media and audience-focussed events and actions relevant to meeting 350 Brasil campaigns goals, increasing reach and strengthening 350\'s brand recognition in Brazil.
  • Create local campaign narratives that connect to issues people care about, making 350 relevant to broader constituencies.
  • Produce, adapt, and publish daily content (copy, images, video) across 350 Brasil social media channels
  • Maintain a content calendar and coordinate with the central Communications team and other local teams
  • Contribute to global storytelling and communications strategy by sharing plans, actions, case studies and achievements.

Media Opportunities and Partnerships:

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

title: Party Chief
description:
UTEC, Acteon's Geo-services business line, harnesses data to optimise designs, save time and maximise your project's economic value by providing a holistic understanding of the marine environment. Our insights underpin customers' decision-making from design to asset life extension, ensuring every decision delivers.

UTEC is looking to add a Party Chief to the team. The Party Chief is UTEC's senior onboard representative and must ensure that all work is conducted in the best interests of UTEC and the Client. They are responsible for the safe, efficient and timely conduct of the project and for the assurance of quality. On site, they shall liaise closely with the Client Representative and Ship's Master and shall manage the day-to-day work program, subject only to direct instruction from or through the Project Manager and, in matters of vessel safety and discipline, the Ship's Master. It is the Party Chief's role to supervise those members of the survey team for whom they are responsible from the standpoint of technical and personal management. The Party Chief shall work closely with the vessel's Master in the event of an emergency or condition requiring shore assistance. The Party Chief shall oversee each use of the current UTEC field reference manuals and standard forms ensuring that, upon demobilization, a copy of any proposed revisions/corrections is saved to file and hard copy returned to the UTEC office within the project file.

The role is based offshore and will require travel to support UTEC operations, periods of onshore support may also be required working either remotely or from UTEC offices/workshops.

The successful candidates will be based in Brazil.

Duties

  • On appointment to the field project, the Party Chief shall manage mobilization in accordance with the Mobilization Procedure (SOP-001)
  • Immediately prior to first sailing, the Party Chief shall email the Project Manager all check lists duly signed and completed to date
  • Ensure that all survey parameters have been checked before the commencement of fieldwork
  • Ensure that all survey systems are in place for the contract and that all pre-sailing checks are carried out and documented
  • Ensure the Survey Event Log Book is comprehensively maintained by the Surveyors
  • Maintain a Rental Equipment list and return to office with Project Site file both hard & electronic
  • Initiate and close out NCR (non-conformance reports)
  • Submit requests for consumables/spares and ensure that the onboard Spares Master Register (on Excel) is maintained up to date
  • The Party Chief shall email signed checklists upon demobilization
  • Document any contractual variations and concessions
  • The Party Chief shall ensure that all data recorded is properly labelled, stored and logged and can be accounted for at all times especially when being prepared for transit. Depending on the nature of the project, much of this work will be performed by others, including the QC Geophysicist, but the Party Chief must ensure there are no 'gaps' in the system as (s)he bears overall responsibility.
  • On completion of mobilization alongside and of all harbor checks and calibrations, the Party Chief shall compile his/her checklist with those of the Senior Surveyor, the QC Geophysicist and the Engineer-in-Charge and after signature, shall send all checklists to the UTEC Operations Manager. Similarly, after signature upon completion of demobilization, these documents shall be sent to the UTEC Operations Manager
  • The Party Chief shall always be alert to the impact the deployment of survey sensors might have upon the vessel's ability to maneuver. Similarly, they shall be aware of the vessel's working location with particular regard to the proximity of structures and other vessels
  • Complete Final Survey Report as per UTEC approved format
  • Undertake field personnel assessments fairly, reflecting individual strength and weaknesses and recommending training as appropriate and submit to the Operations Manager ashore upon the departure of any crew member or upon the occasion of his/her being relieved
  • Fully brief all members of survey crew and key members of the ship's crew. Party Chief shall ensure that a Briefing Meeting is conducted, and a list maintained and signed by all attendees and retained in the project file (FRF-013)
  • Preparation and presentation of safety meetings at project start-up and ongoing toolbox meetings with marine and survey watch operators before deploying equipment or other potentially hazardous operations. Special emphasis is to be given to assist the Master and Safety Officer in promoting safe working practices

Required

  • Bilingual in Portuguese and English, strongly preferred
  • Education in Geomatics, Surveying Science
  • Relevant industry experience or military/academic experience in survey related discipline, including relevant management experience
  • Satisfactory completion of competence criteria for Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor
  • Nominally 48 months' experience, including 400 operational days offshore as Senior Surveyor, Senior Survey Engineer, Senior Geophysicist or Senior Data Processor
